title: native yuv conversion and export sub-stage timing

commit.merge_subject: merge: native yuv conversion and export sub-stage timing

tests: green, 1284 tests 0 failures; buildCMakeDebug[arm64-v8a] compiled both
description:
the owner's export timing sample lines showed the native stage as one
number (native=472.3ms at 4k, effects none); this splits it into the six
internals so the next device measurement can attribute the cost.

- jni_bridge.cpp: nativeExportFrame takes one steady_clock read at each
  boundary (decode / temporal nr / develop / gyro warp / oetf+pack /
  jni copy) into thread-local slots, gated by gExportTiming set from
  buildconfig.debug at library load (the gstabdebuglog pattern): a
  release build reads one relaxed atomic per boundary and collects
  nothing, and the frame bytes are untouched. nativeSetExportTiming
  toggles the gate; nativeExportFrameTimingMs returns the six slots
  (milliseconds, fixed order) or null when the gate is off.
- NativeSource.kt: decls + companion-init wiring beside the stab log
  gate + the internal wrapper.
- Mp4Session.lastFrameSubStagesMs(): the seam, defa
